title: Make Phoenix CLI JSON output budget- and encoding-honest
outcome: Every CLI-generated or pretty-printed JSON response uses Phoenix UTF-8 serialization and stays within the existing ordinary hard response budget with observable trimming.
acceptance: Oversized multibyte CLI-generated errors stay at or below Json.HardBudgetBytes with explicit truncation evidence.
Pretty success output preserves literal non-ASCII text under UnsafeRelaxedJsonEscaping without exceeding the hard budget.

completion.summary: Delivered in commit eee9ee5 as part of the reviewed Phoenix CLI changeset.
